sources.label: RA 9513: Renewable Energy Act of 2008 — Renewable Energy Systems in Buildings
sources.description: Provides framework for integrating renewable energy systems in buildings including solar, wind, biomass, and geothermal.

sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017, Article 6.90 — Alternative Energy Systems
sources.description: Governs installation of alternative energy systems including solar PV, wind turbines, fuel cells, and battery storage systems in buildings.

sources.label: DOE Department Circular — Net Metering Guidelines for Renewable Energy Systems
sources.description: Department of Energy guidelines for grid interconnection of renewable energy systems including metering and compensation mechanisms.
